g.text: travel with the event (ADR-033) -- not yet a StoredEvent column,
picked up by the origin site's own Router, asynchronously (ADR-023)
independently, the origin site's outbox drains on its own schedule
poll for events not yet acked by peer "site-hamburg"
push StoredEvent (full envelope: Payload, PayloadHash, OriginId, LogicalClock, ActorId, ...)
append(StoredEvent) -- lands exactly as if it arrived
from this site's own client Inbox (ADR-033)
SequenceNumber/ChainHash are each site's OWN local chain (ADR-019) --
never copied from the origin's chain, never require it to match.
picked up by the destination site's own Router, asynchronously -- no routing
or schema-validation logic runs during sync itself (ADR-033)
